data.one_liner: Curated collection of all country flags in SVG format for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of SVG flag assets and a widget to display them by country code or ID. It uses flutter_svg to render the SVGs.
use_when: You need to display country flags in a Flutter app
You want a lightweight, static asset collection without network fetching
You prefer SVGs for scalability and styling
avoid_when: You need dynamic flag updates from a remote source
You require custom flag designs not in the collection
strengths: All flags available as SVG assets
weaknesses: No support for custom flag shapes
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic SVG rendering, but you need to supply flag assets yourself

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Can load PNG flags but lacks SVG support
